title: Services must come back on their own: launchd KeepAlive always, Postgres container restart policy, Docker engine at login
description: Measured 2026-09-10: com.rakazo.{api,worker,sandbox-supervisor,web}.plist have KeepAlive={SuccessfulExit:false}, so the api exited with code 0 at ~10:20 and launchd did NOT restart it — site showed 502 on /health for ~80 min until a manual kickstart. The Postgres container compose-postgres-1 has restart=no, and no OrbStack/Docker login item was found, so after a Studio reboot the DB would stay down. Fix: KeepAlive=true (plus ThrottleInterval 10) in ops/launchd/*.plist and the installed plists (bootout+bootstrap); docker update --restart unless-stopped on the postgres container and restart: unless-stopped in infra/compose/docker-compose.postgres-host.local.yml; OrbStack set to start at login. AC: kill -TERM the api pid → launchd restarts it within 15 s and /health returns 200; docker inspect shows restart=unless-stopped; OrbStack start-at-login verified; plists in ops/ match installed; codex gate PASS.

context.text: Applied live 2026-09-10 15:34-15:37 (codex gate PASS on 3f672c6): installed plists KeepAlive=true ThrottleInterval=10 for api/worker/sandbox-supervisor/web (bootout+bootstrap; worker/supervisor/web needed a second bootstrap after 'Input/output error 5' — all 5 agents running after); docker update --restart unless-stopped → compose-postgres-1 restart=unless-stopped; orb config app.start_at_login=true. AC test: kill -TERM of the whole api process group (pgid 33339) → pnpm exited code 0 (same as the 10:20 incident) → launchd restarted api as pid 54026 after 1s → /health 200 after 6s (runs=2). Merge into luke/studio-setup held until gate T-RKZ-011 finishes (avoid base drift).
